gen-dafont-starborn-gf-alexandria: Starborn scatters its letters across wide gaps of blank space, each lowercase line a thick dark stripe floating in a dream. Alexandria is the grounded one, a tall sans with wide-open terminals.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-amiko: Starborn leaves huge gaps between its letters, with a heavy dark band of lowercase running through every line. Amiko takes over where drifting stops, and its outward-pointing terminals give the sans a crisp, upright footing.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-bangla: Dreamy and spaced out, almost floating. Starborn is the one for drama, with dark lowercase stripes between wide gaps, while Anek Bangla does the everyday talking in a sans with broad, barely curled s curves.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-devanagari: Starborn lays out its heavy lowercase in dark stripes, with generous blank space between the letters. And Anek Devanagari handles the reading, a sans with a tall middle zone and distinctly open letter mouths.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-gujarati: Ethereal gaps, dark stripes of lowercase, and a faraway feel. Anek Gujarati is the grounded counterpart, its lowercase nearly rivaling the capitals while a gaping c opening keeps the plain sans easygoing next to Starborn's drifting letters.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Spacey, smoky and slow, with wide gaps between dark lowercase stripes. And Anek Gurmukhi gives the plain sans a generous footing, its open-handed curves and big counters being just what Starborn's drifting letters need.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-kannada: Starborn spreads its dark lowercase stripes across wide stretches of blank space, giving every line a dreamy, drifting feel. Anek Kannada's tall x-height then sets a firm, squared-off ground beneath it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin reads tall and open, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals without ever curling shut. Starborn, the dreamy heading above it, scatters dark stripes across wide gaps, so a long page feels steady beneath it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-malayalam: Starborn floats, with dark lowercase stripes spaced out across wide, dreamy gaps. Anek Malayalam follows as a sans with curves that never quite close and capitals barely above the lowercase, so reading rolls on smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-odia: Wide gaps, dark stripes, a dreamy drift. Starborn takes the larger sizes best, and Anek Odia, with unsealed rounds and capitals only slightly above lowercase, would sit comfortably at a modest size beneath it.
